# dsh-tool-feishu
English | 中文
A Cordis tool plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) Feishu/Lark integration capabilities. Agent
s can list chats, inspect members, read and send messages, list users, browse calendars and events,
and review approval instances, details, and task actions.

## Configuration
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The optional `baseUrl` must be an absolute `http://` or `https://` root URL. Only publicly reachable
hosts are allowed: localhost, loopback, private, link-local, CGNAT, multicast, reserved/documentati
on/benchmark ranges, and every IANA special-purpose block are rejected, and a hostname whose DNS res
ults contain any such address fails closed before the request is sent. Credentials, query strings, f
ragments, and non-root paths are not allowed.

## Approval workflow
Typical usage for approvals:

1. Use `feishu_list_approval_instances` to find the instance.
2. Use `feishu_get_approval_instance`

to inspect the instance detail and task IDs.
3. Use `feishu_approve_approval_task` or `feishu_reject
_approval_task` to act on a task.
The approve/reject tools can resolve `approvalCode` and `instanceCode` from the detail tool when you
only pass `instanceId`, `taskId`, and `userId`.
